# ChartDataPoint

<!-- Generated from the doc comments in the library. Do not edit this file. -->

Represents one named numeric value in a chart series.

Import from `@bonniepdf/core`.

## Constructors

```typescript
new ChartDataPoint(options?: ChartDataPointOptions)
```

## Properties

- [`formattedValue`](#formattedvalue): Gets the formatted value string based on Value and LabelFormat.
- [`label`](#label): Category label for the point, shown on the axis or in the legend.
- [`labelFormat`](#labelformat): Number format for `formattedValue`: `G` (default), `F<n>`, `N<n>` or `P<n>`.
- [`value`](#value): Numeric value of the point.

### `formattedValue`

```typescript
readonly formattedValue: string
```

*read-only*

Gets the formatted value string based on Value and LabelFormat.

### `label`

```typescript
label: string
```

Category label for the point, shown on the axis or in the legend.

Example, from `code-recipes/comparison-charts/horizontal-grouped-bar-chart`:

```typescript
p.label = q;
```

Example, from `code-recipes/comparison-charts/bar-chart`:

```typescript
p.label = label;
```

### `labelFormat`

```typescript
labelFormat: string
```

Number format for `formattedValue`: `G` (default), `F<n>`, `N<n>` or `P<n>`. Culture-invariant; see [`formatChartNumber`](format-chart-number.md). Anything else throws when the chart is drawn.

Example, from `code-recipes/comparison-charts/bar-chart`:

```typescript
p.labelFormat = 'N0';
```

Example, from `code-recipes/compliance-archival/attached-data`:

```typescript
point.labelFormat = 'N0';
```

### `value`

```typescript
value: number
```

Numeric value of the point.

Example, from `code-recipes/comparison-charts/horizontal-bar-chart`:

```typescript
p.value = r.value;
```

Example, from `code-recipes/comparison-charts/bar-chart`:

```typescript
p.value = values[i];
```
